about: Course thumbnails for docs/Course_Catalogue_Website.xlsx (Course Master record IDs). Each image in public/Thumbnail Samples is named after an LMS course name and its printed title was checked against the course. An image is shared only by records the workbook groups under the same LMS name (Name Key). Courses without a confirmed image keep the placeholder. Build: python3 scripts/build-course-thumbnails.py
